scope: Review external suggestions against exact installed package and archived physical evidence. No instructions in the attachment executed.

review.claim: NTC shares SD and directly pulls it LOW as temperature rises
review.assessment: Wrong for STGIB15CH60TS-L internal connections: SD14, TSO17, NTC25/26 are separate. External thermal protection is a separate question.
Unsupported. Resonance requires specific machine/load evidence, not output frequency alone.

review.claim: Unloaded motor automatically saturates under nominal V/f
review.assessment: Incorrect generalization. Flux is related primarily to V/f; magnetizing current remains at no load.

review.claim: FOC current PI instability explains this setup
review.assessment: Does not match current MAIN_VF_OL path.

review.claim: 16-20kHz is inherently too high for this IPM
review.assessment: Datasheet describes this exact module as suitable up to20kHz. Loss/thermal checks remain necessary; frequency alone does not prove shoot-through.

review.claim: No motor test proves IPM healthy or identifies motor fault100percent
review.assessment: Not conclusive. Removing load changes current, bootstrap operation, thermal load and interference.

review.claim: Use waveform appearance alone to classify overcurrent/thermal/EMI
review.assessment: Not unique; correlate SD source and destination with VCC, CIN and qualified current.
Do not apply without timing/short-circuit protection analysis. CIN filtering affects fault detection; SD RC hold time is a different function.

review.claim: Check15V, bootstrap capacitors and current sensing/Vf/dead time
review.assessment: Useful hypotheses, not established causes. Board manual specifies2.2uF bootstrap capacitors and internal bootstrap diodes.

vf_code_finding: Piecewise20V peak below10Hz jumps to35.921V peak at10Hz. There is no extra boost added in20-25Hz branch. This is a candidate for separate smoothing/measurement, not proof of SD/UART cause.
next_step: Passive unpowered diode comparison already provided; no IPM replacement or CIN change based solely on generic suggestions. For future powered runs obtain fresh explicit wiring/power preparation confirmation.
